2607.03882.title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
2607.03882.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstream model has produced probabilistic outputs characterized by their likelihood and uncertainty, and LLMs are tasked with selecting an appropriate verbal descriptor for each. We simulate predictions from an upstream model by taking samples from a Beta distribution parameterized by its mode and prior sample size. We then prompt LLMs to explain these predictions under six domain contexts and with ten temperature settings, and repeating each experiment ten times. We find that LLMs are generally consistent but miscalibrated, with substantially weaker performance on uncertainty than on likelihood tasks. Providing models with precomputed summary statistics (mode and prior sample size) reduced sensitivity to contextual framing but did not resolve the underlying miscalibration, suggesting that the bottleneck resides in the verbalization step itself. These findings indicate that current LLMs do not yet constitute reliable zero-shot standalone risk communication tools for probabilistic predictions.
2607.03882.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 正在越來越多地被用作 AI 生成輸出的事後解釋者，但目前尚不清楚它們是否能夠可靠地以自然語言傳達概率信息。<lb/>要使這一角色可行，模型必須對相同的輸入產生相同的口頭描述，並選擇準確反映基礎數量大小的描述。<lb/>我們評估九個 LLM 是否在一個兩階段的預測管道中滿足這些要求，在這個管道中，上游模型產生了以其可能性和不確定性為特徵的概率輸出，而 LLM 的任務是為每個輸出選擇合適的口頭描述。<lb/>我們通過從以其模式和先前樣本大小參數化的 Beta 分佈中抽樣來模擬上游模型的預測。<lb/>然後，我們在六個領域背景下和十個溫度設置下提示 LLM 解釋這些預測，並重複每個實驗十次。<lb/>我們發現 LLM 通常是一致的，但校準不準，對不確定性任務的表現顯著弱於對可能性任務的表現。<lb/>提供模型預先計算的摘要統計（模式和先前樣本大小）減少了對上下文框架的敏感性，但並未解決根本的校準不準問題，這表明瓶頸存在於口頭化步驟本身。<lb/>這些發現表明，當前的 LLM 尚未構成可靠的零樣本獨立風險傳達工具，用於概率預測。
